verdict.rationale: The only recurring automation in the evidence is topic monitoring: Undermind watches saved topics and sends ongoing alerts when relevant papers are published, which is a recurring job the user sets up. There is no evidence of a general scheduler for arbitrary searches or workflows. Batch processing and API queries are one-off or programmatic, not scheduled. Missing for 10: user-defined schedules or cadence control, recurring execution of arbitrary research workflows, scheduling via MCP or API, and independent corroboration of the alerts feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Get notified whenever relevant papers are published.
Role-aware alerts: Monitors saved topics and sends concise updates tailored to each teammate’s role and active projects.
